purpose: Handbook page for word problems (the largest handbook page).
details: Explains the four steps (Lees, Plan, Reken, Controle), operating keys, the klad syntax, answering at once, the four tips, the worked solution after checking, how stories are generated, the Speurneus, estimating and checking, points and what parents see. It follows the fixed work method of the main handbook page. Tables per school year and the list of thinking errors and the cheat sheet are generated by docs/tools/handleiding.py between auto markers; the screenshots show the 0.19 menus.
summary: Explains word problems in four steps with the Flemish Gegeven-Gevraagd-Oplossing-Antwoord scheme: keys and mouse, the klad notation, immediate answers with a second chance, four graded tips, the worked solution and reasonableness check, how stories are built from structure, world, numbers and wording, the Speurneus (find the mistake), estimating and 'can that be right', the points and what the parent report shows.
